name: a full pool with no temp/perm split renders filled dots
temporary below permanent renders spent glyphs for the difference
temporary above permanent renders overflow glyphs, not clamped
temporary equal to permanent renders no overflow or spent glyphs
exactly 10 glyphs does not trigger compression
exactly 11 filled glyphs collapses the leftmost run of five, leaving 6 remaining plus the capital
a 15-point pool (e.g. Blood) collapses twice down to two capitals plus the remainder
a large uniform pool stops compressing once at or under 10 characters
spent runs collapse from the right, leaving the uncollapsed remainder on the left
overflow runs collapse from the right, leaving the uncollapsed remainder on the left
spent is collapsed before filled when both are present
